subject.title: Feature request: Persistent task-status surface for long-running channel turns

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent per-channel-turn status surface, and should the canonical owner be runtime/session activity, the task ledger, or channel transport?
rationale: The requested behavior is useful but the owner choice determines persistence, restart semantics, Discord rollout, config defaults, plugin SDK shape, and how existing progress/task/status surfaces avoid competing sources of truth.

options.title: Runtime-Owned Status Contract
options.body: Add a canonical runtime/session status model and let Discord project it first as best-effort editable status.

options.title: Task-Ledger Extension
options.body: Broaden task records to cover normal channel turns, accepting a larger semantic change to what counts as a task.

options.title: Keep Existing Surfaces
options.body: Treat progress drafts, typing, task commands, and Web UI status as sufficient and close or narrow this request.

recommendation.title: Runtime-Owned Status Contract
recommendation.body: Add a canonical runtime/session status model and let Discord project it first as best-effort editable status.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent cross-surface history in the Discord, channel lifecycle, and task-state files that would need to be composed.
